rationale: The bug's terminology ('Observer look-angles', 'wrong geodetic model', 'WGS84') maps directly to satellite/look-angles.ts, whose observerEci uses a spherical Earth (RE = 6378.137 km constant) — a limitation the in-source comment itself flags as 'spherical Earth; ellipsoid/altitude refinement later'. The three listed invariants (vernal equinox → RA 0/Dec 0, ecliptic north pole → Dec=90−obliquity, meridian body → zenith) sounded like they belong in the coordinate-transform pipeline and pulled the failed patch into astronomy/horizontal.ts, but the math in eclipticToEquatorial/equatorialToHorizontal already satisfies all three; the actual error lives one layer down in the geodetic-to-ECI step that feeds the SEZ rotation used by lookAngle.
